overview_description.description:
Odyssey Interactive is a Canadian Game Development studio formed around the mantra of building "Games you Live". Odyssey believes that the best games are the ones you think about long after you put them down, that help you feel like you're a part of something bigger than yourself, and that you believe you can invest in for years to come.

The company is on a mission to build games with the same emotional potential as the games we fell in love with growing up, but designing them with a mobile first mindset. Odyssey believes the next generation of gamers is going to the be most connected, the most diverse, and the most relentlessly driven generation this world has ever seen - and for them phones aren't just a tool, they're an extension of their body. We believe they deserve the same quality of games that we feel in love with so many years ago.

The founding team is comprised of four former leads from Riot Games, where they led teams such as a the League of Legends Balance Team, the League of Legends Champion Design team, and the development of Teamfight Tactics - and are excited to try to build a world class studio with an awesome team.
